description:
Owner's law (2026-07-02): follow_up is an anti-northstar SMELL — a job imperatively enqueueing other jobs is control-flow smuggled into a dataflow engine. The northstar admits exactly two reasons work runs: a consumer WAITS on a named fact/product (pull), or a CHANGED REVISION wakes a recorded reader. Every .18.12-family pathology (duplicate fires, late-enqueue re-runs, the deleted seal's self-scheduling) is a push symptom; the .18.19 concluded-coalesce is a SCREEN on the push, not a cure — its removal criterion is zero emissions.

INVENTORY (2026-07-02, post-spine-deletion; production emissions): jobs/body.rs (~72 refs — DeriveTypeDef, ReifyGuardDispatch pushes from lowering), jobs/semantic.rs (~66), jobs/root.rs (SeedRoot pushes LowerFunction/PlanEntryDispatch/AnalyzeActivation + gated_follow_up), jobs/dispatch.rs (DeriveTypeDef/ReifyGuardDispatch/DefineFunction), jobs/keying.rs (DefineFunction/LowerFunction), jobs/contract.rs (DeriveTypeDef), jobs/types.rs, jobs/source.rs, source_publish.rs, quoted_expander.rs, world.rs. The artifact/product layer is already pull (pull.rs has 1 residual ref).

THE MIGRATION SHAPE (proven in-tree): consumers express missing prerequisites as FACT WAITS; the driver's fact->producer map (demand_product_fact_producer, compiler.rs / jobs/backend.rs) demands the single producer for a missing FactKey. Extend that map to cover the semantic facts (TypeDefined, GuardDispatchReified, FunctionDefined, LoweredBody, EntryDispatch, ActivationAnalyzed, ...); convert each emission site to a wait; SeedRoot shrinks to publishing root facts only (demand pulls the rest). Work consumers-backward per family (DeriveTypeDef pushes first — they are the most numerous and most mechanical), one commit per family, trace-proven per the minimal-job-trace gate (job counts must drop or hold; no behavior change; products byte-identical).

DONE = rg shows zero production follow_up emissions; JobEffects::follow_up field deleted; the .18.19 coalesce screen deleted (nothing left to screen); scheduler wake paths = changed-revision only; docs updated (fact-engine.md drops 'legacy jobs may enqueue follow-ups').

SEQUENCING: blocked by fz-go4.18.22 (the demand redesign reworks the same semantic files; migrating around an oscillating fixpoint would churn). The in-flight .18.19 removable-code audit's emission classification (KEEP/REMOVE/CONDITIONAL) is the starting inventory — attach its findings here.

comments.text: STARTING INVENTORY from the .18.19 removable-code audit (2026-07-02, at 424b2ae6a): (1) FIRST REMOVAL, proof complete: seed_root's LowerFunction + PlanEntryDispatch follow_ups (root.rs:75-76) are provably ALWAYS-COALESCED — the concluding branch requires Recursive+DispatchMask facts, whose producers (keying.rs:148-152 -> body.rs:287; keying.rs:84-90 -> dispatch.rs:169) must therefore have concluded; first-run demand already lives in DeriveRecursive/DeriveDispatchMask; change waves handle re-runs. Safe to delete as this arc's first family (own commit). (2) KEEP-classified: root.rs:77/:112 AnalyzeActivation (genuine first-run demand for a just-minted activation); ALL other emissions are absence-gated wait+demand pairs (semantic.rs:219/1257/1301/1492/1647/2265, dispatch, body, keying, source, world.rs:2094/2102, quoted_expander, source_publish) — these are the wait-implies-demand conversion targets. (3) Product-side jobs (artifact/runtime_demand/transport/backend/native) emit ZERO follow_ups already. (4) Minor: the coalesced telemetry channel conflates agenda-dedupe (scheduler.rs:257) with standing-conclusion suppression (scheduler.rs:228-232) — split the observability when this arc lands. (5) Watch item from the cross-lane note: semantic.rs:1255-1258 demands DefineModule(protocol) while waiting on ProtocolDispatch — the one site where a follow_up forced a concluded job's re-run as a wait-unblocking mechanism; resolve its real producer relationship during migration.

title: Migrate the semantic layer off follow_up: work runs only via waits (pull) or changed-revision wakes
